scenes.title: Built for every country
scenes.subtitle: Currency, tax, phone numbers and language
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro started in India, but agencies everywhere use it. Each agency works in its own currency, tax system, time zone and language.
Thames and Tide Travel in Bristol works in pounds, with British dates and London time, set when the agency was created.
Its invoices carry VAT instead of GST. The tax engine also handles sales tax, reverse charge, or no tax at all.
Phone fields start with the agency's country code, and the picker knows more than two hundred countries.
Desert Pearl Tours in Dubai sees dirhams and Gulf time.
Switch the language to Arabic, and the core screens turn right to left: the navigation, the dashboard, leads, contacts and itineraries. Hindi is on the way.

scenes.heading: One platform, many markets
scenes.narration: Pick the country when the agency is created, and the rest follows: currency and tax, local time for every scheduled job, a price list in your own currency, and daily exchange rates kept on the platform.
